WELCOME TO HENRY COUNTY, IOWA


 
 


 


 
 
 
 


 

 100 E. Washington Street Mount Pleasant


 
 
 






 
 
 
 


 

Board of Supervisors


 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 


 


 
 


 
 


 
 
 
 


 

The Henry County Board of Supervisors and all of the individual County departments would like to welcome you to the Official Henry County Government web site.
The purpose of this site is to extend the Court House and many of it's public services onto the internet and into your home or office. It is our desire to provide our services in an efficient and convenient manner to the citizens of Henry County, and interests outside our county, 24 hours a day/7 days 
a week/365 days a year.

  Driver License Hours
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
2027 renewal period for off highway vehicles and snowmobiles has begun and will end December 31, 2026. Customers can renew their vehicles after January 1, 2027 but they will pay a $5.00 late penalty.

 

 

 

 

Beginning 1/22/2024, Pursuant to 321M.9, customers 
who do not reside in Henry County will be assessed a $10.00 convenience fee for driver’s license services unless they pay property taxes in Henry County and provide proof of payment.

 

 
 

 

 

 

 
 

 

 

Driver License Hours 
Monday - Friday 8:30 am - 4: 00 pm.
